description.text: The Faculty of Biological & Environmental Sciences is composed of three departments including Bioscience, Environmental Science and Food Science. The faculty provides five bachelor degree programs, namely biotechnology, bioengineering, environmental science, food science and engineering as well as food quality and safety. It has set up key municipal laboratories---the Ningbo Agricultural Product Processing Laboratory and three other research institutes including the Institute of Biotechnology, the Institute of Microbiology and Environmental Sciences Research Center. The facilities for education and experiments are of the highest standard. There are basic biology and environment laboratory, laboratories of chemistry, biotechnology, bioengineering, environmental protection and food technology in the experimental center. Moreover, many modern facilities are available therefore experiments relating to molecular biology and environmental and food tests can be carried out there. The faculty attaches great importance to the dual aim of training qualified personnel and the integration of theory and practice, and to the cooperation with other universities at home and abroad. So far the faculty has established cooperative programs with Zhejiang University, University of Dundee, University of Hertfordshire etc. 2. Undergraduate Programs Department Undergraduate Program Degree Conferred Bioscience Biotechnology Bachelor of Science Bioengineering Bachelor of Engineering Environmental Science Environmental Science Bachelor of Science Department of Food Science Food Science and Engineering Bachelor of Engineering Food Quality and Safety Bachelor of Engineering

duration.text: The Biological Science at Zhejiang Wanli University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
